description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseImageEditConfig' for configuring image editing in a language model framework. It includes abstract methods for handling parameters, environment validation, URL formation, request and response transformation, and multipart form data usage, tailored for different image editing providers.

classes.name: BaseImageEditConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class for image editing configuration, defining the necessary methods for parameter handling, request/response transformation, environment validation, and provider-specific settings.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration properties defined in subclasses, filtering out private and callable attributes.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Abstract method to get a list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, image_edit_optional_params: ImageEditOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Abstract method to map openai parameters and optional request params to provider-specific dictionary.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Abstract method to validate environment headers and API keys, returning a dictionary of environment info.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the complete URL for the API request, some providers require the model in api_base.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict,RequestFiles] transform_image_edit_request( self, model: str, prompt: str, image: FileTypes, image_edit_optional_request_params: Dict, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Abstract method to transform input parameters into request headers and files for image editing.

methods.name: ImageResponse transform_image_edit_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Abstract method to process the raw HTTP response into an internal ImageResponse object.

methods.name: bool use_multipart_form_data(self)
methods.description: Utility method to indicate if the provider expects multipart/form-data for requests; defaults to True.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Method that raises a BaseLLMException with provided error message, status, and headers.
